options.content: Direct L1 linker metrics, grouped by worker. **Lookup coverage is the maximum locally restorable page boundary on successful owner queries**, before cross-rank intersection; repeated/resumed queries count again. Non-owner acknowledgements are excluded from hits and I/O. Load operations are batches; offload operations are owner nodes. Queue time starts at worker-queue insertion (not scheduler pending-load admission). Operation latency ends at worker completion, before ordered result publication. Physical I/O is measured per pool/layer shard, from submission to Wait confirmation; pages are not deduplicated across layers or ranks. **Cache completion does not imply downstream Posix persistence**. Check failures are also included in connector completion errors; do not add those two series. Queue estimates can briefly lag because export is periodic. GB/s means decimal bytes/s. Missing series remain No data; no zero-fill or synthetic latency samples.

panels.title: Local restorable page coverage
panels.description: Successful owner queries only; not final cache token hit rate. Zero queries give no valid ratio.
